sources.label: Midas mTBILL source: mToken inheritance and pause role
Midas mToken source: sender and recipient blacklist checks

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26224764 (2026-10-19), mTBILL proxy 0xdd629e5241cbc5919847783e6c96b2de4754e438 resolves to verified implementation 0xd4998cc1ba435298c521f250b81856b1f25c8455. mTBILL inherits mToken, whose _beforeTokenTransfer applies _onlyNotBlacklisted to both sender and recipient, and exposes pause()/unpause() under M_TBILL_PAUSE_OPERATOR_ROLE plus privileged burn under M_TBILL_BURN_OPERATOR_ROLE. The blacklist is administered through shared MidasAccessControl 0x0312A9D1Ff2372DDEdCBB21e4B6389aFc919aC4B: BLACKLIST_OPERATOR_ROLE (0x2fdc6683bc8d03effec5b41d3834f28bd219e06ca0a6a26fc737e44b1c7889ff) had 60+ current holders at that block (hasRole true for 0x081bb8ad7f452f916991c17fdfa64d4a25153169, 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2, 0x1202ac80145f26a7d59b3d7a64836dbacd6bd424), so an issuer operator can add any holder to BLACKLISTED_ROLE and stop its transfers. Ethereum held 69,657,307.70 of 71,133,334.91 mTBILL (97.93%) measured across the five deployments at pinned totalSupply reads, a material deployment. Etherlink (1,139,160.06; 1.60%), Base (336,492.09; 0.47%), Plume (374.19) and Rootstock (0.86) are sub-threshold and disclosed, not verdict-setting; their proxies reuse the same mToken design but were not role-verified.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: October 1 pinned reads confirm mTBILL token identities and EIP-1967 proxy paths on Ethereum, Base, Rootstock, Plume and Etherlink. The issuer-listed issuance vaults hold M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on Ethereum, Base, Rootstock and Etherlink; the listed Plume vault does not hold that role at block 96626537. These reads do not establish an exhaustive minter census or exclude additional cross-chain adapters. The issuer contracts repository contains LayerZero and Axelar integrations, but their deployment-specific mTBILL use is not established by this review.
